scope: Narrowed by the INFRA-115 architect past review_round_cap=3: judge the three round-1 findings and the required CI at the new head; also check that the per-process broker_serving rows are pruned or bounded, and that enrollment_lease_live's read of the latest row stays an indexed lookup at all nine sites (either missing is a correctness defect).

keyFindings.description: enrollment_lease_live's read of the latest row is not indexed. broker_serving has only its primary key on process, and the function body runs `order by last_serving_at desc limit 1`, so each call seq-scans and sorts the table. Postgres does not inline the function and calls it once per evaluated row at all nine sites. Measured on Postgres 16.4 (127.0.0.1:54487, throwaway schema, dropped after), with 20000 lapsed enrollments and the EndLapsed predicate: 50 rows and no index 826 ms; 5050 rows and no index 31178 ms; 5050 rows with `create index on broker_serving (last_serving_at desc)` 293 ms; 50 rows with that index 322 ms. Fix: add that index in 0019, which is unreleased, and prove it with EXPLAIN of the function's lookup.

roundOneFindings: main.go clock start: fixed in 301addfd. clock.Run(serving) now starts after close(serveStarted), beside srv.Serve. TestABrokerThatDiesBeforeServingRecordsNoServingBeat runs the real binary into exchangeKeys' fatal() and finds broker_serving unchanged. The implementer's negative control (clock at its old place) fails.

Beat deadline: fixed in 301addfd. context.WithTimeout(Interval), with lock_timeout, statement_timeout and idle_in_transaction_session_timeout set_config'd local to its transaction, and a WARN carrying timed_out. With one row per process, a held row stalls only that process's beat (TestAHeldServingLockFailsTheBeatAndAnotherBrokerKeepsTheGuardOff).

Contract change census: present in the body. I re-ran its rg search at the head: the same 12 files, each with a disposition. I re-ran gh search code on theorem-labs/agent-infra: [] for both names, and the BROKER_DATABASE_URL positive control finds the broker files. The rollout is an immediate refusal naming what it closes.

architectChecks.rowsBounded: Holds. Each beat deletes rows more than servingPrune (1 h) behind the latest (serving.go, delete ... for update skip locked), in the same transaction after its own row is written, so a process that exited leaves its row for at most an hour after any broker beats. TestABeatPrunesRowsAnHourBehindTheLatest covers it.
